The '''TX7 Long-Range Probe''' was a model of [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] that was employed by the forces of [[House of Thul|House Thul]] during the [[Alderaan Civil War]]. A number of TX7 Long-Range Probes were deployed to the [[Alsakan Lowlands]], a region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] near the [[House Organa (estate)|estate]] of Thul's rival [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]].<ref name="TOR" />
